learning_outcomes.text: Students have broad and deep knowledge in the field of particle measurement technology, especially size analysis.
Students are able to interpret measurement results according to different measurement procedures.
Students develop an understanding for the interpretability of measurement results in the field of particle measurement technology.
Students are able to select measurement methods according to the process engineering requirements.
Students receive knowledge at the latest technical-scientific standard.
Students are able to discuss measurement results in the field of particle measurement technology.
Students learn to work professionally on a scientific basis.

syllabus_topics: Importance, application areas and measurement objectives
Equivalence diameter depending on various measurement methods
Presentation, evaluation, and interpretation of measurement results
Measurement methods and devices: optical methods, sedimentation methods, field disturbance methods, mechanical methods, acoustic methods
Methods for surface determination and flow behavior
